source.text: saint.gr, το εορτολόγιο της 19ης Μαΐου — «Άγιοι Νεομάρτυρες εν Σλομπόντσκαγια Ουκρανίας»

attestations.note: The life page heads «Τύπος εορτής: Σταθερή. Εορτάζει στις 19 Μαΐου εκάστου έτους», the same day as the listing. The company is enumerated — twenty-seven men named one by one, with patronymics, birthplaces and the months of their deaths — so it is twenty-seven folders and not one, by docs/CORPUS.md §10.1. Nothing in the corpus answers to any of these surnames: a grep of `saints/` for all twenty-seven returned nothing, and no folder mentions Kharkov except `meletius-of-kharkov`, a bishop of the eighteen-hundreds. His own head line reads «Αγιος Γαβριηλ ο Ιερομαρτυς (1880 - 1938)», and his sentence in the page's list is quoted whole in the life. His is the one sentence in the list that does not call him Ιερομάρτυς — it reads «Ο Άγιος Γαβριήλ» — while his head line does, «Αγιος Γαβριηλ ο Ιερομαρτυς». The head line is followed for the type and the difference is said here.
Not checked: the Ohrid Prologue on pravoslavno.rs for the corresponding Julian day (30 September 2026).
